status: partial — strong structural constraints + new soft theorem; explicit closed form still open
summary: Top-down attack on the three-minus n>=6 closed form. New exact result: a UNIFORM SOFT THEOREM A_n^{3-} -> 2(n-3) omega_p^2 A_{n-1} as any leg omega_p -> 0 (surviving amp is three-minus for a soft plus leg, the KNOWN two-minus for a soft minus leg), factor 2(n-3)=6 verified exactly at n=6 by rational Richardson extrapolation. This re-derives the universal prefactor i 2^{n-1} g^{3-n} and exponent n-3 and shows every leg is a 'knot' (soft-omega^2), pointing to a d=3 box spline / multivariate truncated power (deg = N-d = n-3). Ruled out a large family of explicit closed forms exactly (even-in-omega^2, prod(omega)*linear, e2*poly, double-subset resonance splines for p=2,3,4 and |.|, same-type and mixed-type pair sums); the chamber polynomial has genuine mixed parity and is not a 1-D B-spline. Found on-shell identity e2(minus)=e2(plus). Literature: no published closed form for this sector.
